headline: Ross sales rose 21% on a 17% comp, crushing guidance as traffic surged; full-year outlook raised.
guidance_note: FY26 comp raised to +6-7%, EPS $7.50-7.74 (excl. potential tariff refunds). Q2 comp +6-7%, EPS $1.85-1.93.
key_messages: Comp +17% vs flat LY, driven by transactions rather than basket; customer counts up across income levels, ages and ethnicities.
Conroy credited assortments, marketing and store experience, and said larger tax refunds helped and may not be sustainable.
Operating margin 13.4%, up 120 bps and above 11.8-12.1% plan; EPS $2.02 vs $1.60-1.67 guidance.
Packaway 36% of inventory vs 41% LY; tariff refund claims filed but excluded from guidance.

consumer.income_split: Customer count gains across all income levels, per management.
consumer.pricing: Tariff refund claims filed; timing and amounts uncertain so excluded from guidance.

macro_read: Larger 2026 tax refunds plus value-seeking drove an exceptional spring for off-price, with traffic gains across all income groups.

sources.label: Motley Fool: why Ross stock is up
